name: Weather Timeline Pro
description:
Weather Timeline Pro for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

See the next 24 hours as a continuous weather ribbon built for the Edge's wide display. Current conditions stay anchored while the timeline shows temperature, conditions, precipitation chance, daylight and darkness, and solar transitions at the time they actually occur.

Tap any hour for feels-like temperature, precipitation amount, wind speed and direction, and UV. Larger layouts add a concise three day high and low overview. Compact layouts keep the same data glanceable with a touch-controlled first 12 / next 12 hour view.

Save up to three locations and tap the location header to switch quickly between them. Pro also adds civil dawn and dusk context plus eight presentation themes.

Forecasts are cached per widget instance, so a temporary provider failure leaves the last successful forecast readable with a clear stale indicator.

Weather access uses iCUE automatically when available. If your iCUE build does not provide weather access, you can paste your own free WeatherAPI.com key in settings as a local fallback.

No alerts or air-quality panel are included in V1: the product stays focused on the forecast information that is most useful at a glance.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial Pro release. 24 hour timeline, richer precipitation, wind speed and direction, feels-like temperature, UV, three saved locations with touch switching, three day overview, civil dawn and dusk context, eight themes, rich touch hour details, cached stale-data fallback, and all eight XENEON Edge layouts.
